r: A **matrilineal, matrilocal** joint family of a woman, her brothers and sisters, and her own and her sisters' **sons and daughters** (and daughters' children); husbands do not live in it – no husband–wife or father–child relation inside
The husband had **no legal paternity** – children have no legal genitor/father in the tharavad (Gough's test case of marriage)
Matrilineal; women free; children go to the mother after divorce; clan exogamy, parallel cousins barred
In matrilineal societies the **maternal uncle** holds authority (avunculate)
Patrilineal Brahmins; joined Nair women only in **sambandham**
The **Konkan Navayats** (coastal Karnataka-Konkan) and the Mappilas of north Kerala
India's – the first national programme in the world
